datasets.title: Bangladesh - Kutupalong Refugee Camp - Struture Footprint - March 2020 - Fire Affected Camps
datasets.description: Kutupalong Rohingya Refugee Camp, Bangladesh. The structure footprint covers the camps directly affected by the fire of the 22nd March 2021 (Camp 8E, Camp 8W and Camp 9). The footprint is based on high resolution drone imagery from March 2020 (IOM) and has been processed by REACH/UNOSAT. The footprint includes all digitised structures and so includes bridges, shelters and smaller structures, such as latrines etc. This footprint is an early release of the full structure/shelter footprint for all camps and has not been QCed. Users should use accordingly. The full, QCed, post-processed structure/shelter footprint for all camps will be released in mid-April.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kutupalong-refugee-camp-struture-footprint-march-2020-fire-affected-camps]

lineage.description: Structure footprints were digitized from high-resolution drone imagery acquired by IOM in March 2020 and processed by REACH/UNOSAT. The dataset covers all structures (shelters, bridges, latrines) in camps 8E, 8W, and 9 of Kutupalong refugee camp, which were directly affected by the fire of 22 March 2021. This early release has not undergone full quality control.
